# Task

The activity kit goes to the printer on Friday and I need a pre-flight pass over the
batch before it does. Everything is in `input/`: the artwork batch, the section list
saying how each section is bound and which stock it runs on, the stock profiles, and
our PRINT-KIT-2 standard.

Apply the standard as written. Most of the limits belong to the paper stock rather than
to the kit, parts of the batch have been re-supplied since the first drop, and the
standard carries an amendment — each of those changes which pages are actually in
breach. The sections carry a rule of their own, and it reads the page audit.

Save `activity_kit_audit.csv` with one row per audited page, keyed by `page_id`, and a
`finding` column carrying the code for every rule that page breaches — join multiple
codes with `|`, and use `none` for a page that breaches nothing.

Save `section_summary.csv` with one row per section and the columns `section_id`,
`binding`, `stock_code`, `live_page_count`, `held_back`, `imposed_page_count`,
`flagged_pages`, `imposition`, in that order, using the same `none` convention in
`imposition` for a section that imposes cleanly.

Then write `activity_kit_memo.md` for the studio. Account for every page carrying a
finding, naming the measured value and the limit it missed. Where a page's numbers look
like a breach but the standard clears it, say what clears it. Say which artwork the
batch supersedes and what that changes. Give me the limits you actually applied — the
stocks in this kit and their resolution floors, ink caps, margin floors and bleed
minimums. Cover every section, and name the ones that cannot be imposed with the number
of pages each of them needs. And state the batch totals: how many pages are clear, how
many carry a finding, and how many required elements the batch is missing altogether.

---
Save your deliverables into your current working directory using exactly these filenames:
    - `activity_kit_audit.csv` — Per-page print-production audit
    - `section_summary.csv` — Per-section rollup
    - `activity_kit_memo.md` — Markdown memo for the studio
    - `results.json` — a JSON object with the keys `page_count` (pages audited),
      `superseded_count` (artwork rows the batch supersedes), `section_count`,
      `clean_count`, `flagged_count`, `finding_total` (every finding raised across the
      batch, not the number of pages carrying one), `dpi_low_count`, `margin_count`,
      `bleed_short_count`, `ink_over_count`, `element_short_count` (each of these five
      counting the pages carrying that finding), `element_shortfall_total` (how many
      required elements the batch is missing in total), `imposition_invalid_sections`
      and `imposition_shortfall_total` (how many pages those sections need between them)
- Writing those files is the required deliverable and must be your final action; confirm each one exists before you answer.

---

## Working environment

- Your current working directory is `/app`, and it is writable.
- The read-only attachments referred to as `input/` are at `/app/input`.
- Write every deliverable into `/app`, at the exact filenames listed above.

1: # Printable activity-kit production standard (PRINT-KIT-2)
2: 
3: Binding for the artwork batch in `activity_kit_pages.csv`. §2–§7 are checked against every
4: live page; §8 is checked against every section.
5: 
6: ## 0. Batch scope and revisions
7: 
8: The batch file lists *artwork*, not pages. A page that has been re-supplied appears more
9: than once, once per `revision`, under the same `page_id`. Only the highest-numbered
10: revision of a `page_id` is live artwork and goes to press; every lower revision is
11: superseded and is not audited. The rows are not in revision order. Every figure reported
12: for the batch counts live pages only.
13: 
14: ## 1. Sections, binding and stock
15: 
16: Each page belongs to a section (`kit_sections.csv`), and the section fixes both the binding
17: and the paper stock that section is printed on. The limits in §2–§5 are properties of the
18: **stock** (`stock_profiles.csv`), not of the kit as a whole, so the same measurement can be
19: a breach in one section and clear in another.
20: 
21: Every limit in this standard is inclusive: a measurement exactly equal to its limit meets
22: the limit. Only a measurement strictly worse than the limit is a breach.
23: 
24: ## 2. Effective resolution
25: 
26: Artwork is supplied at `artwork_dpi` and placed on the page at `placement_scale_pct`. What
27: actually prints is the effective resolution:
28: 
29:     effective_dpi = floor(artwork_dpi * 100 / placement_scale_pct)
30: 
31: A page placed larger than 100% therefore resolves *lower* than its supplied figure, and one
32: placed smaller resolves higher. Below the stock's `min_dpi` it is `DPI_TOO_LOW`.
33: 
34: ## 3. Safe margin
35: 
36: `margin_in` must be at least the stock's `min_margin_in` — the clear distance between any
37: text or graphic element and the trim edge. Below it is `MARGIN_VIOLATION`.
38: 
39: ## 4. Full-bleed pages: one exemption, one obligation
40: 
41: A page tagged `full_bleed_design` is **exempt from §3**. Its art is meant to run to the trim
42: edge, so a thin margin on a full-bleed page is by design; flagging it is the commonest false
43: positive in this audit.
44: 
45: **The exemption is limited to saddle-stitched sections.** Perfect binding glues the spine
46: edge, so a perfect-bound page has no bleed on that edge and its live copy still has to clear
47: the trim: a full-bleed page in a `perfect_bound` section is judged under §3 exactly like any
48: other page. Only a full-bleed page in a `saddle_stitch` section is released from §3.
49: 
50: Every full-bleed page, whatever its binding, carries an obligation no other page carries: it
51: must be supplied with `bleed_in` of at least the stock's `min_bleed_in`, or the trim eats
52: into the art. Below it is `BLEED_SHORT`. `bleed_in` on a page that is not full-bleed is not
53: assessed.
54: 
55: ## 5. Ink coverage
56: 
57: `total_ink_pct` must not exceed the stock's `max_ink_pct`. Above it is `INK_OVER`.
58: 
59: ## 6. Required elements
60: 
61: Each page type carries a minimum number of required elements:
62: 
63: | page_type | minimum |
64: | --- | --- |
65: | `cover` | 1 |
66: | `parent_guide` | 2 |
67: | `map` | 4 |
68: | `activity` | 4 |
69: | `mission_cards` | 6 |
70: | `bingo` | 9 |
71: | `badge_certificate` | 4 |
72: 
73: **Amendment Rev B.** A saddle-stitched section is trimmed harder at the outer edge, so its
74: detachable-element pages have to be supplied with spares. In a section bound
75: `saddle_stitch`, the minimum for `mission_cards` and for `badge_certificate` is
76: 2 higher than the table above. No other page type and no other binding is
77: affected.
78: 
79: A page below its own minimum is `ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT`. A page's shortfall is its minimum
80: less its `element_count`; a page at or above its minimum has a shortfall of zero.
81: 
82: ## 7. Findings
83: 
84: `finding` is one or more of `DPI_TOO_LOW`, `MARGIN_VIOLATION`, `BLEED_SHORT`, `INK_OVER`,
85: `ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT`, joined with `|`, or `none` for a page that breaches nothing.
86: 
87: ## 8. Imposition
88: 
89: A page carrying `ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT` cannot go to press as it stands: it is **held back**
90: for re-supply and does not sit in the imposition. What has to impose is the section's live
91: page count *less* the pages held back.
92: 
93: That imposed count has to fit the section's binding:
94: 
95: | binding | imposed page count must be |
96: | --- | --- |
97: | `saddle_stitch` | a multiple of 4 |
98: | `perfect_bound` | a multiple of 2 |
99: 
100: A section whose imposed page count does not fit its binding is `IMPOSITION_INVALID` and has
101: to be repaginated before the run; the pages it needs is the number that would carry it up to
102: the next multiple. A section that fits is `none`.
103: 
104: §8 is a property of the section, not of any page in it: an `IMPOSITION_INVALID` section is
105: not a finding against its pages, and a section with no flagged pages at all can still fail
106: to impose.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pre-flight audit of the activity-kit artwork batch against PRINT-KIT-2."""
import csv
import math
import json
from collections import defaultdict, OrderedDict

INPUT = "/app/input"

# ---- Load stock profiles ----
stocks = {}
with open(f"{INPUT}/stock_profiles.csv", newline="") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        stocks[r["stock_code"]] = {
            "stock_name": r["stock_name"],
            "min_dpi": int(r["min_dpi"]),
            "min_margin_in": float(r["min_margin_in"]),
            "max_ink_pct": int(r["max_ink_pct"]),
            "min_bleed_in": float(r["min_bleed_in"]),
        }

# ---- Load sections ----
sections = OrderedDict()
with open(f"{INPUT}/kit_sections.csv", newline="") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        sections[r["section_id"]] = {
            "section_name": r["section_name"],
            "binding": r["binding"],
            "stock_code": r["stock_code"],
        }

# ---- Load artwork batch ----
rows = []
with open(f"{INPUT}/activity_kit_pages.csv", newline="") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        r["revision"] = int(r["revision"])
        r["artwork_dpi"] = int(r["artwork_dpi"])
        r["placement_scale_pct"] = int(r["placement_scale_pct"])
        r["margin_in"] = float(r["margin_in"])
        r["full_bleed_design"] = r["full_bleed_design"].strip().lower() == "true"
        r["bleed_in"] = float(r["bleed_in"])
        r["total_ink_pct"] = int(r["total_ink_pct"])
        r["element_count"] = int(r["element_count"])
        rows.append(r)

# ---- Determine live artwork: highest revision per page_id ----
by_page = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    by_page[r["page_id"]].append(r)

live = {}
superseded = []
for pid, rws in by_page.items():
    rws_sorted = sorted(rws, key=lambda x: x["revision"])
    live_row = rws_sorted[-1]
    live[pid] = live_row
    for r in rws_sorted[:-1]:
        superseded.append(r)

# ---- Element minimums (base table + Rev B amendment) ----
BASE_MIN = {
    "cover": 1,
    "parent_guide": 2,
    "map": 4,
    "activity": 4,
    "mission_cards": 6,
    "bingo": 9,
    "badge_certificate": 4,
}


def element_minimum(page_type, binding):
    base = BASE_MIN[page_type]
    if binding == "saddle_stitch" and page_type in ("mission_cards", "badge_certificate"):
        return base + 2
    return base


# ---- Audit each live page ----
audit_rows = []  # ordered by page_id
findings_by_page = OrderedDict()

# order by page_id
for pid in sorted(live.keys(), key=lambda p: int(p.split("-")[1])):
    r = live[pid]
    sec = sections[r["section_id"]]
    stock = stocks[sec["stock_code"]]
    binding = sec["binding"]

    codes = []

    # §2 Effective resolution
    eff_dpi = math.floor(r["artwork_dpi"] * 100 / r["placement_scale_pct"])
    if eff_dpi < stock["min_dpi"]:
        codes.append("DPI_TOO_LOW")

    # §3 / §4 margin
    # full_bleed exempt from §3 ONLY in saddle_stitch sections
    margin_exempt = r["full_bleed_design"] and binding == "saddle_stitch"
    if not margin_exempt:
        if r["margin_in"] < stock["min_margin_in"]:
            codes.append("MARGIN_VIOLATION")

    # §4 bleed obligation for full-bleed pages
    if r["full_bleed_design"]:
        if r["bleed_in"] < stock["min_bleed_in"]:
            codes.append("BLEED_SHORT")

    # §5 ink
    if r["total_ink_pct"] > stock["max_ink_pct"]:
        codes.append("INK_OVER")

    # §6 elements
    emin = element_minimum(r["page_type"], binding)
    if r["element_count"] < emin:
        codes.append("ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT")

    finding = "|".join(codes) if codes else "none"
    findings_by_page[pid] = {
        "page_id": pid,
        "artwork_id": r["artwork_id"],
        "page_name": r["page_name"],
        "page_type": r["page_type"],
        "section_id": r["section_id"],
        "binding": binding,
        "stock_code": sec["stock_code"],
        "artwork_dpi": r["artwork_dpi"],
        "placement_scale_pct": r["placement_scale_pct"],
        "effective_dpi": eff_dpi,
        "min_dpi": stock["min_dpi"],
        "margin_in": r["margin_in"],
        "min_margin_in": stock["min_margin_in"],
        "full_bleed_design": r["full_bleed_design"],
        "bleed_in": r["bleed_in"],
        "min_bleed_in": stock["min_bleed_in"],
        "total_ink_pct": r["total_ink_pct"],
        "max_ink_pct": stock["max_ink_pct"],
        "element_count": r["element_count"],
        "element_minimum": emin,
        "element_shortfall": max(0, emin - r["element_count"]),
        "finding": finding,
        "codes": codes,
    }

# ---- Build per-page audit CSV ----
with open("/app/activity_kit_audit.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["page_id", "finding"])
    for pid in sorted(findings_by_page.keys(), key=lambda p: int(p.split("-")[1])):
        w.writerow([pid, findings_by_page[pid]["finding"]])

# ---- Section summary + imposition ----
section_rows = []
imposition_invalid = []
imposition_shortfall_total = 0
for sid, sec in sections.items():
    binding = sec["binding"]
    stock_code = sec["stock_code"]
    # live pages in this section
    pages_in_sec = [pid for pid, info in findings_by_page.items() if info["section_id"] == sid]
    live_count = len(pages_in_sec)
    held_back = [pid for pid in pages_in_sec if "ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT" in findings_by_page[pid]["codes"]]
    held_back_count = len(held_back)
    imposed = live_count - held_back_count
    flagged = [pid for pid in pages_in_sec if findings_by_page[pid]["finding"] != "none"]
    flagged_count = len(flagged)
    # imposition check
    if binding == "saddle_stitch":
        multiple = 4
    else:
        multiple = 2
    if imposed % multiple == 0:
        imposition = "none"
        needs = 0
    else:
        imposition = "IMPOSITION_INVALID"
        needs = multiple - (imposed % multiple)
        imposition_invalid.append(sid)
        imposition_shortfall_total += needs
    section_rows.append({
        "section_id": sid,
        "binding": binding,
        "stock_code": stock_code,
        "live_page_count": live_count,
        "held_back": held_back_count,
        "imposed_page_count": imposed,
        "flagged_pages": flagged_count,
        "imposition": imposition,
        "needs": needs,
        "flagged_page_ids": flagged,
        "held_back_page_ids": held_back,
    })

with open("/app/section_summary.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["section_id", "binding", "stock_code", "live_page_count", "held_back",
                "imposed_page_count", "flagged_pages", "imposition"])
    for sr in section_rows:
        w.writerow([sr["section_id"], sr["binding"], sr["stock_code"],
                    sr["live_page_count"], sr["held_back"], sr["imposed_page_count"],
                    sr["flagged_pages"], sr["imposition"]])

# ---- results.json aggregates ----
page_count = len(findings_by_page)
clean_count = sum(1 for i in findings_by_page.values() if i["finding"] == "none")
flagged_count = page_count - clean_count

finding_total = 0
counter = {"DPI_TOO_LOW": 0, "MARGIN_VIOLATION": 0, "BLEED_SHORT": 0,
           "INK_OVER": 0, "ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT": 0}
for i in findings_by_page.values():
    for c in i["codes"]:
        finding_total += 1
        counter[c] += 1

element_shortfall_total = sum(i["element_shortfall"] for i in findings_by_page.values())

results = {
    "page_count": page_count,
    "superseded_count": len(superseded),
    "section_count": len(sections),
    "clean_count": clean_count,
    "flagged_count": flagged_count,
    "finding_total": finding_total,
    "dpi_low_count": counter["DPI_TOO_LOW"],
    "margin_count": counter["MARGIN_VIOLATION"],
    "bleed_short_count": counter["BLEED_SHORT"],
    "ink_over_count": counter["INK_OVER"],
    "element_short_count": counter["ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT"],
    "element_shortfall_total": element_shortfall_total,
    "imposition_invalid_sections": len(imposition_invalid),
    "imposition_shortfall_total": imposition_shortfall_total,
}
with open("/app/results.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

# ---- Diagnostic dump for memo building ----
print("=" * 70)
print("STOCKS APPLIED")
for code, s in stocks.items():
    print(f"  {code} {s['stock_name']}: min_dpi={s['min_dpi']} "
          f"min_margin={s['min_margin_in']} max_ink={s['max_ink_pct']} "
          f"min_bleed={s['min_bleed_in']}")

print("=" * 70)
print(f"TOTAL ARTWORK ROWS: {len(rows)}")
print(f"LIVE PAGES: {page_count}")
print(f"SUPERSEDED ROWS: {len(superseded)}")
for s in superseded:
    print(f"  superseded: {s['artwork_id']} page={s['page_id']} rev={s['revision']} "
          f"(live -> {live[s['page_id']]['artwork_id']} rev={live[s['page_id']]['revision']})")

print("=" * 70)
print("PER-PAGE AUDIT (live pages)")
for pid in sorted(findings_by_page.keys(), key=lambda p: int(p.split("-")[1])):
    i = findings_by_page[pid]
    print(f"{pid} [{i['section_id']} {i['binding']} {i['stock_code']}] "
          f"art={i['artwork_id']} r={live[pid]['revision']} type={i['page_type']} "
          f"eff_dpi={i['effective_dpi']}(min {i['min_dpi']}) "
          f"margin={i['margin_in']}(min {i['min_margin_in']}) "
          f"fb={i['full_bleed_design']} bleed={i['bleed_in']}(min {i['min_bleed_in']}) "
          f"ink={i['total_ink_pct']}(max {i['max_ink_pct']}) "
          f"elems={i['element_count']}(min {i['element_minimum']}, short {i['element_shortfall']}) "
          f"-> {i['finding']}")

print("=" * 70)
print("SECTION SUMMARY")
for sr in section_rows:
    print(f"{sr['section_id']} {sr['binding']} {sr['stock_code']} "
          f"live={sr['live_page_count']} held_back={sr['held_back']} "
          f"imposed={sr['imposed_page_count']} flagged={sr['flagged_pages']} "
          f"imposition={sr['imposition']} needs={sr['needs']}")
    if sr['flagged_page_ids']:
        print(f"   flagged: {sr['flagged_page_ids']}")
    if sr['held_back_page_ids']:
        print(f"   held_back: {sr['held_back_page_ids']}")

print("=" * 70)
print("results.json")
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

# Activity-kit pre-flight audit — PRINT-KIT-2

Pre-flight pass over the artwork batch in `input/activity_kit_pages.csv` against the
PRINT-KIT-2 standard, with `input/kit_sections.csv` supplying each section's binding and
stock and `input/stock_profiles.csv` supplying the limits. Figures count **live artwork
only**: of the 42 artwork rows in the batch, 6 are superseded lower revisions and 36 pages
go to press. Section binding fixes the stock, the stock fixes the §2–§5 limits, and §8
imposition reads the per-page audit.

Companion files: `activity_kit_audit.csv` (one row per audited page, `page_id`,`finding`),
`section_summary.csv` (one row per section), `results.json` (batch totals).

---

## 1. Limits actually applied

Every limit is **inclusive** — a measurement exactly equal to its limit meets it; only a
strictly worse measurement is a breach. The §2–§5 limits are properties of the **stock**, so
the same number clears in one section and fails in another.

| stock_code | stock | min_dpi (resolution floor) | min_margin_in (margin floor) | max_ink_pct (ink cap) | min_bleed_in (bleed minimum) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CST-100 | Coated silk 100gsm | 300 | 0.125 | 280 | 0.125 |
| UNC-120 | Uncoated offset 120gsm | 240 | 0.1875 | 240 | 0.25 |
| BRD-250 | Board 250gsm | 260 | 0.25 | 300 | 0.1875 |

Effective resolution is computed, not read: `effective_dpi = floor(artwork_dpi × 100 / placement_scale_pct)`.

**§6 required-element minimums** (base table): `cover` 1, `parent_guide` 2, `map` 4,
`activity` 4, `mission_cards` 6, `bingo` 9, `badge_certificate` 4.

**Amendment Rev B** raises the minimum for `mission_cards` and `badge_certificate` by **2**
in any `saddle_stitch` section, so the applied minimums there are `mission_cards` 8 and
`badge_certificate` 6. No other page type, and no `perfect_bound` section, is affected. The
pages whose breach status the amendment changes are called out in §3 and §4 below.

**§4 full-bleed rules** — two of them:
- A `full_bleed_design` page is **exempt from §3 (margin)** **only in `saddle_stitch`
  sections**. In a `perfect_bound` section a full-bleed page is judged under §3 like any
  other — the glued spine edge has no bleed and the live copy still has to clear the trim.
- **Every** full-bleed page, in either binding, must carry `bleed_in ≥ min_bleed_in`
  (`BLEED_SHORT`). `bleed_in` on a non-full-bleed page is **not assessed** (so the many
  `0.0` bleeds on non-full-bleed pages are not breaches).

---

## 2. Batch scope — revisions and superseded artwork

Six `page_id`s were re-supplied and appear more than once; only the highest revision is
live. **6 artwork rows are superseded; 36 pages are audited.**

| live artwork (revision) | supersedes (revision) | page | what the re-supply changes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AW-1034 (r2) | AW-1004 (r1) | PG-04 Kit Map | r1 was clean. r2 is supplied at 220 dpi placed at 80% (effective 275 dpi — still ≥ 260), but margin drops 0.30→0.24 in (now < 0.25) and ink rises 250%→305% (now > 300%). **Adds `MARGIN_VIOLATION` + `INK_OVER`** where r1 had none. |
| AW-1030 (r3) | AW-1012 (r1) | PG-12 Mission Cards B | r1 carried 9 elements (clear of the Rev-B saddle min of 8). r3 carries 7. **Adds `ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT`** (shortfall 1). |
| AW-1031 (r2) | AW-1018 (r1) | PG-18 Station Bingo 3 | r1 was `MARGIN_VIOLATION` only. r2 drops bleed 0.25→0.10 in (now < 0.125) and raises ink 260%→285% (now > 280%). **Adds `BLEED_SHORT` + `INK_OVER`** on top of the carried-over margin violation. |
| AW-1032 (r2) | AW-1027 (r1) | PG-27 Certificate B | r1 effective 200 dpi was `DPI_TOO_LOW`. r2 is supplied at 480 dpi placed at 200%, effective `floor(480×100/200)` = 240 dpi = the UNC-120 floor. **Clears the `DPI_TOO_LOW`** — PG-27 is now clean. |
| AW-1040 (r2) | AW-1037 (r1) | PG-33 Mission Cards H | r1 had 9 elements (clear of Rev-B saddle min 8) and `INK_OVER` only. r2 has 7 elements. **Adds `ELEMENT_COUNT_SHORT`** (shortfall 1) on top of the carried-over `INK_OVER`. |
